name: Clear floor baseline
functions: sensor inputs report a clear path
expected: With no adjacent obstacles or dust, the C controller selects forward movement and clean-and-mop behavior.

name: Dust at initial position
functions: clean and mop with boost request
expected: The controller selects forward movement and clean-and-mop behavior and requests temporary power increase when dust is detected.

name: Front obstacle
expected: The controller selects turn-aside followed by forward movement and reports stop-then-clean-and-mop behavior.

name: Left obstacle
expected: Any detected obstacle selects the general avoidance sequence; the C output leaves the turn side abstract.

name: Right obstacle
expected: Any detected obstacle selects the general avoidance sequence and stop-then-clean-and-mop output.

name: Front and left obstacles
expected: Because fewer than all three sensed directions are blocked, the general turn-aside and forward sequence is selected.

name: Front and right obstacles
expected: The partial-obstacle response is selected; the map lets the evaluator inspect the simulator's turn-side convention.

name: Both sides blocked, front clear
expected: The all-three-directions condition is false, so the controller selects the general obstacle response.

name: Front and both sides blocked
expected: The controller selects backward, turn-aside, then forward and reports the final cleaning state as unspecified.

name: Front obstacle with dust
expected: The movement response is obstacle avoidance and the C output independently requests a dust power boost; priority is not defined.

name: Left obstacle with dust
expected: The C controller selects partial-obstacle movement and requests temporary power increase for the detected dust.

name: Right obstacle with dust
expected: The C controller selects partial-obstacle movement and requests temporary power increase for the detected dust.

name: All directions blocked with dust
expected: The controller selects backward recovery and reports the boost request; cleaning behavior in this combined case requires human evaluation.

name: East-facing front obstacle
expected: The obstacle directly east is reported as front relative to heading; partial-obstacle movement is selected.

name: South-facing front obstacle
expected: The obstacle directly south is reported as front relative to heading; partial-obstacle movement is selected.

name: West-facing front obstacle
expected: The obstacle directly west is reported as front relative to heading; partial-obstacle movement is selected.

name: East-facing all directions blocked
expected: Front, left, and right relative to east are all blocked; backward recovery is selected.

name: South-facing obstacle with dust
expected: The side obstacle keeps this out of the all-blocked case; dust detection requests temporary power increase.

name: Dust with two side obstacles
expected: The two side obstacles do not meet the all-three condition; the controller selects general avoidance and requests a dust boost.

name: Dust encountered after forward movement
expected: After moving forward onto the dust cell, a subsequent C-controller decision should report dust and request temporary power increase.
